versions.changelog:
- Simplified SKILL.md content to focus solely on the "热搜榜" (hot search) feature.
- Updated description and trigger conditions to reflect the narrower scope: only viewing the hot search list.
- Removed instructions and documentation for searching, playing, TUI, history, and playback control.
- Installation instructions retained; usage reduced to a single example for checking the hot search.
- Audience now clearly directed to use this for 漫播热搜榜 only.

Initial release of manbo-cli — CLI tool for searching and browsing Chinese radio dramas.

- Search and view trending radio dramas from kilamanbo.com directly in the terminal.
- Commands include hot search list and keyword-based radio drama search (with pagination support).
- Provides prompts when search keywords are not specified.
- Simple installation with npm and easy command-line workflow.
